**SYNAPSE REWORK RESEARCH QUESTIONNAIRE**

*Completed via External Research • February 2026*

*This document contains research-backed answers to all 225 questions in
the Synapse rework questionnaire. Answers draw on Discord API
documentation, PostgreSQL best practices, event sourcing literature,
anti-gaming research, and community platform design patterns. Questions
requiring internal project decisions (marked with confidence: Low)
identify specific actions that must be completed by the project owner
before architecture work can proceed. Every answer follows the
structured template: Answer, Confidence (High/Medium/Low), Source, and
Notes.*

# **Section 1 --- Non-Negotiables (Must Know Without Doubt)**

*These answers define the immovable constraints of the system. Every
architectural decision must be reconcilable with these answers before
proceeding.*

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q1**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               **What exact categories of Discord events must be captured even if we never reward them?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  Moderation events (member joins, leaves, bans, kicks, role grants/revocations), message deletes and bulk deletes, thread archiving/unarchiving, channel creation/deletion, and voice state changes (join/leave/mute). These matter for audit integrity, anti-gaming correlation, and projection correctness even when no reward rule matches them.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 **Source: ***Discord Gateway Docs + observability best practices*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **The list of always-captured events should be hardcoded in bot config and not overridable by guild admins, to protect audit integrity.                                                                                                                                                                                         
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q2**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  **What data fields are forbidden to persist (privacy, policy, legal, institutional rules)?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  Raw message content (unless MessageContent intent is approved and a clear legal basis exists), presence/activity data (games being played, status strings), IP addresses of end users, voice audio, and any field not directly required for reward logic. Discord\'s Developer Policy also prohibits storing data beyond what is functionally needed.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    **Source: ***Discord Developer Policy; GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation principle*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Confirm with your institution whether FERPA applies if members are students. If so, treat user-identifiable behavioral records with heightened caution.                                                                                                                                                                          
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q3**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               **What is the required retention period for raw observed telemetry?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  Best practice for community bots is 90--365 days for raw event rows, with projection (aggregate) tables kept indefinitely. One year is a reasonable default: long enough to replay a full academic year\'s worth of activity, short enough to limit exposure. Partitioning by month makes enforcing this cheap via partition drop.   
  **Confidence: Medium**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               **Source: ***GDPR data minimisation + common discord analytics practice*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Decision owner must ratify the exact window. This is a policy decision that affects legal exposure, not just architecture.                                                                                                                                                                                    
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q4**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     **Is telemetry immutable in practice (append-only + no in-place edits), yes or no?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
  Yes. Raw event rows must be append-only with no UPDATE or DELETE of original rows. Corrections are handled by inserting compensating events (e.g., a REDACTION envelope row) rather than mutating history. This is essential for replay determinism and audit integrity.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       **Source: ***Event sourcing principle; SoftwareMill event sourcing guide*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Schema migrations may add columns but must never alter the semantics of existing rows.                                                                                                                                                              
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q5**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      **What is the acceptable convergence window for config/rule changes (e.g., seconds/minutes)?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  60 seconds is a practical and achievable target for rule propagation from publish to enforcement. The API reads rules from DB; bots can subscribe to a pg_notify channel or poll every 30--60 seconds. Sub-second propagation requires a message bus (Redis pub/sub) and is probably overkill for a student club context.   
  **Confidence: Medium**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      **Source: ***Practical eventual consistency patterns; pg_notify documentation*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Decide whether the bot pulls rules on a timer or is push-notified. Push (pg_notify) is more responsive but adds one more dependency.                                                                                                                                                                 
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q6**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         **Is eventual consistency acceptable for rewards and projections? If yes, what max delay is acceptable?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  Yes --- for the student-club scale, eventual consistency is acceptable with a maximum lag of 5 minutes for user-visible projection updates (leaderboards, point totals). Real-time correctness is not needed for that use case. However, idempotent writes and at-least-once processing are required to ensure no event is permanently lost.   
  **Confidence: Medium**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         **Source: ***General eventual consistency patterns; Discord community analytics use cases*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Communicate the lag to end users via a freshness indicator in the dashboard UI.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q7**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 **Which admin roles are allowed to create/modify reward rules vs. deploy schema/config changes?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  Two tiers are recommended: Guild Admins (Discord roles) may create, edit, and publish reward rules within their guild via the dashboard; Server Operators (whoever manages the Docker Compose stack) control schema migrations, environment config, and global defaults. These are distinct trust levels that must not be conflated.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   **Source: ***Principle of least privilege; multi-tenant admin best practices*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Consider adding an Approver role between Author and Publisher for sensitive rule changes --- see Section 10.                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q8**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      **What is the minimum anti-gaming baseline that must always remain active, even with custom rules?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  Four always-on controls: (1) a per-user per-event-type daily cap, (2) a minimum time interval (cooldown) between the same event type being rewarded for the same user, (3) self-interaction exclusion (e.g., you cannot earn from reacting to your own messages), and (4) bot-authored message exclusion.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        **Source: ***Common community gamification anti-gaming literature; Discord bot design patterns*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **These four controls are non-negotiable and must be enforced at the rule evaluator level, not as optional rules that admins can disable.                                                                                                                                              
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q9**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           **Which decisions must be explainable/auditable to admins after the fact?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  All of: which rule matched for a given event, what action was applied, what the resulting reward delta was, which anti-gaming control suppressed a potential reward, any rule change (who made it, when, what it was before), and any config deployment. Admin actions must be audit-logged with actor identity and timestamp.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             **Source: ***Transparency and accountability principle; GDPR Art. 22 explainability for automated decisions*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Explainability is also a product differentiator --- it builds admin trust in the system.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q10**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               **What is the rollback requirement for rules (point-in-time restore, version rollback, both)?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  Version rollback (restoring a previous named snapshot of the full ruleset) is the minimum viable requirement. Point-in-time restore of individual rules is a nice-to-have for v2. The key capability is: any prior published ruleset must be re-activatable with a single admin action, and the system must log the rollback as an auditable event.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  **Source: ***Auditable rule lifecycle best practices; GitOps versioning patterns*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Store each published ruleset as an immutable snapshot with a sequential version number, not as a diff.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q11**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               **Are there data export/deletion obligations (e.g., for members leaving a guild)?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  Under GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure) and many institutional policies, yes --- you must be able to delete or anonymize all personally identifiable data for a specific user on request. The practical approach is to replace their Discord user ID with a synthetic null ID in event rows (redaction), preserving aggregate history without PII.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  **Source: ***GDPR Art. 17; Discord Developer Policy data deletion requirements*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Implement a /gdpr-delete admin command or API endpoint from day one, not as an afterthought.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q12**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                **What is the worst-case tolerated data loss window (if any) for observed telemetry?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  For a student-club deployment, losing up to 5 minutes of events during a crash/restart is acceptable if it happens rarely (no more than once per month). Achieving this requires PostgreSQL WAL-level durability (synchronous_commit = on, the default) and a graceful shutdown handler in the bot that flushes its in-memory queue.   
  **Confidence: Medium**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 **Source: ***PostgreSQL durability guarantees; operational resilience best practices*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **If durability requirements harden, consider a lightweight queue (SQLite WAL or Redis stream) as a buffer before DB writes.                                                                                                                                                                                      
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q13**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              **Must reward outcomes be replay-deterministic from event history + rule snapshots?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  Yes --- this is a core architectural requirement. Given the same ordered sequence of observed events and the rule snapshot that was active at each event\'s timestamp, the evaluator must produce identical reward outcomes every time. This means no use of wall-clock time inside rule logic, no random elements, and no external state reads during evaluation.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 **Source: ***Event sourcing + CQRS determinism principle*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Write a replay harness as part of the test suite from the start --- this forces determinism to be baked in rather than bolted on.                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q14**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            **Are we allowed to rely on eventual recomputation, or must user-facing counters be instantly accurate?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Eventual recomputation with a bounded lag (up to 5 minutes) is acceptable for public-facing leaderboards and point totals. Instant accuracy is not required. However, the system should show a last-updated timestamp on any projection that may lag, so users understand the freshness of what they are seeing.   
  **Confidence: Medium**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             **Source: ***Eventual consistency UX patterns; user trust research*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Consider showing \'Last updated X minutes ago\' rather than hiding the eventual consistency behind a fake spinner.                                                                                                                                                                          
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q15**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  **Which environments matter most for this migration: local dev, single-server self-host, managed cloud?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  The current Docker Compose topology (db, bot, api, dashboard) targets local dev and single-server self-host as the primary environments. Managed cloud is a future concern. The architecture should therefore favor simplicity over distributed-system complexity --- a single PostgreSQL instance with partitioning is preferable to a Kafka pipeline for this scale.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     **Source: ***Stack context from questionnaire header; 12-factor app principles*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Do not over-engineer for cloud scale now, but design the event envelope and projection interfaces so they could be adapted to a queue-based pipeline later without schema changes.                                                                                                                                                                
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# **Section 2 --- Discord Event Surface & Availability**

*These questions define what data the Gateway actually exposes and where
the seams between gateway-available and REST-only data lie.*

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q16**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      **Which Discord event families are currently exposed by discord.py for your target use cases?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  discord.py 2.x (Gateway v10) exposes all standard event families: messages (on_message, on_message_edit, on_message_delete, on_bulk_message_delete), reactions (on_reaction_add, on_reaction_remove), voice states (on_voice_state_update), member events (on_member_join, on_member_remove, on_member_update), guild events (on_guild_channel_create, etc.), thread events (on_thread_create, on_thread_update), and interaction events (on_interaction). Poll events were added in API v10 and are surfaced as interaction or message events depending on the poll type.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         **Source: ***discord.py 2.x docs; Discord Gateway v10 event reference*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Always specify Intents.all() minus presences during development, then prune down to exact needed intents before production.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q17**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              **For each desired event family, what fields are available at gateway time vs requiring REST fetch?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  At gateway time: message author snowflake, channel snowflake, guild snowflake, timestamp, attachment metadata, embed presence, reaction emoji, voice channel snowflake. REST-only: full guild member profile (roles, join date) if member cache is not populated, full message history (for threading context), and some attachment MIME types. Enable Intents.members to maximize what arrives at gateway time and avoid costly REST round-trips.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 **Source: ***Discord Gateway event payloads documentation; discord.py intent documentation*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **REST fetches during hot-path event processing will bottleneck throughput. Prefer caching guild members at startup via Intents.members.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q18**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       **Do poll events expose enough structure to classify creation/votes/close reliably?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  As of Discord API v10, polls emit MESSAGE_POLL_VOTE_ADD and MESSAGE_POLL_VOTE_REMOVE gateway events for votes, and poll metadata is embedded in the message object at creation time. Closure fires a MESSAGE_UPDATE event. This is sufficient to classify creation, vote, and close as distinct telemetry event types, though poll_id must be used as the correlation key across all three.   
  **Confidence: Medium**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        **Source: ***Discord API changelog for poll events; discord.py 2.6+ event model*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Verify discord.py 2.6.4 exposes poll events as first-class objects vs raw payload dicts --- you may need on_raw_poll_vote_add if not.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q19**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  **Are gift keyboard interactions visible in gateway events as actionable data?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  Gift interactions (Discord Nitro Gift sending) are not exposed as actionable gateway events for third-party bots. They appear only within the Discord client experience and are not reflected in the public gateway event stream. Treat this as a dead end --- do not model it in your event taxonomy.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     **Source: ***Discord API limitations; third-party bot scope documentation*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **No follow-up needed. This is a confirmed gap in the public API surface.                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q20**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     **Are sticker usages exposed uniformly across message contexts?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  Sticker metadata is included in MESSAGE_CREATE event payloads as a stickers array when a message contains stickers. However, this requires the message_content intent is NOT needed for sticker metadata --- the stickers field is not gated by MessageContent. Stickers in DMs behave differently and are outside guild telemetry scope.   
  **Confidence: Medium**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      **Source: ***Discord message object documentation; MessageContent intent FAQ*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Test sticker usage in forum posts and thread replies specifically, as attachment handling can differ by channel type.                                                                                                                                                                                                
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q21**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           **Can we reliably distinguish pasted image vs uploaded file vs link-embed?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  Partially. Uploaded files appear in message.attachments with MIME type. Link embeds appear in message.embeds. Pasted images are treated as attachments by Discord (content_type: image/\...) so they are indistinguishable from explicit file uploads at the API level. You can classify by checking attachment.content_type, but you cannot reliably separate paste vs upload.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              **Source: ***Discord message payload structure documentation*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Accept this limitation --- record attachment presence and MIME category but do not rely on paste-vs-upload distinction in reward rules.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q22**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     **How are forum post creation and forum reply represented differently in event payloads?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  Forum post creation fires as THREAD_CREATE (because a Discord forum post is a thread) followed by MESSAGE_CREATE with the initial message. A forum reply is a standard MESSAGE_CREATE in the thread channel. The key discriminator is whether channel.parent_id maps to a forum-type channel (type 15). Replies also have a thread field absent from standalone messages.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        **Source: ***Discord forum channel documentation; thread API event structure*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Store channel type in your event envelope so replay logic can correctly classify forum vs regular channel messages without re-fetching.                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q23**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             **What is the reliable signal for \'reply chain depth\' in forum/thread contexts?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  Reply chain depth is not directly available from the gateway payload. The message.reference field gives the parent message ID, but that alone does not give depth without a traversal query. For practical telemetry, classify by: is_reply = message.reference is not None. True depth counting would require a recursive DB query and is probably not worth implementing at v1.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                **Source: ***Discord message reference documentation; practical bot design*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Consider tracking is_reply as a boolean feature rather than computing depth --- depth adds complexity without clear reward value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q24**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               **Are message edit and message delete events required in telemetry scope?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  Yes --- both should be captured. Message deletes are required for anti-gaming (detecting spam-delete-repeat loops) and audit integrity. Message edits should be captured as metadata events (recording that an edit occurred and the timestamp), but the new content should not be stored unless MessageContent intent is approved.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  **Source: ***Anti-gaming best practices; audit trail design*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Bulk message delete (on_bulk_message_delete) fires a list of message IDs --- ensure your envelope can handle batch inserts for this event type.                                                                                                                                                                
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q25**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  **Do we need to capture reaction remove events for intent modeling, not just reaction add?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  Yes, for anti-gaming purposes. Without reaction removes, users can repeatedly add and remove reactions to trigger the add event reward each time. The pair of add+remove within a short window is a strong signal of gaming the system. Capture removes as a separate event type and use them to cancel or flag suspicious add events.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     **Source: ***Discord.py reaction event docs; anti-gaming heuristics design*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Note from discord.py docs: on_reaction_remove does NOT include member info --- only user ID and emoji. Plan your envelope accordingly.                                                                                                                                                                            
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q26**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             **Do mentions need typed breakdown (user/role/channel/everyone/here)?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  Yes. Message payloads include message.mentions (user mentions), message.role_mentions, and message.mention_channels, plus boolean flags for mention_everyone and mention_here. Distinguishing these types enables fine-grained rules (e.g., reward mentioning a role but not spamming \@everyone) and prevents gaming through mass-mention abuse.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                **Source: ***Discord message object mention fields documentation*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Everyone/here mentions should likely carry a negative reward signal or at minimum trigger an anti-spam check.                                                                                                                                                                                                                
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q27**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     **Is attachment MIME type always available and trustworthy from payloads?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  Attachment content_type is provided by Discord but is derived from the file extension and Discord\'s own type detection, not cryptographically verified. It is generally reliable for common types (image/png, application/pdf) but should be treated as advisory rather than authoritative. Do not use MIME type alone for security-sensitive decisions.   
  **Confidence: Medium**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      **Source: ***Discord attachment object documentation*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **For reward rules based on attachment type (e.g., rewarding code file uploads), accept content_type as good-enough and document the limitation.                                                                                                                                                                                       
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Q28**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       **Which voice state transitions are essential (join/leave/move/mute/deafen/stream/video)?**
  **Answer:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  Essential: join (channel_id transitions from null to populated) and leave (channel_id transitions to null). Important: move (channel_id changes from one non-null value to another). Lower priority: mute/deaffen/stream/video --- these are state modifiers within a session but rarely warrant independent rewards. Capture all via on_voice_state_update and derive the transition type by comparing before/after state.   
  **Confidence: High**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          **Source: ***Discord voice state documentation; discord.py VoiceState object*
  **Notes / Follow-up: **Store session start time at join so session duration can be computed as a feature for time-in-voice rewards.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
